sections.content:
Hungarian has very expressive set idioms using *-vá / -vé*:
- **Kővé dermed**: to freeze in shock / to petrify (literally: to stiffen into stone)
- **Hóvá / semmivé lesz**: to vanish into thin air (literally: to turn to snow / nothing)
- **Divattá válik**: to become fashionable / trendy
- **Szokássá válik**: to become a habit
- **Valósággá válik**: to come true / become reality

items.english: From surprise I almost froze like stone.

items.spanish: A régi szokások az új helyen divattá váltak.
items.english: Old customs became trendy in the new place.
